purpose: Operator review packet for the machine-readable standards pack layer.

what_was_created.standards_pack_manifest: Canonical manifest listing all standards artifacts
what_was_created.external_registry: Registered 7 external standards (OWASP, MITRE, NIST, CycloneDX, SPDX, OpenSSF) — not downloaded
what_was_created.schemas: 8 JSON schemas for validating standards artifacts
what_was_created.internal_canons: 12 quality canons covering visual, motion, face, anatomy, identity, timeline, preview, audio, voice, assembly, state audit
what_was_created.role_standards: 7 role standards (QA, QC, Tester, Visual QA, Script Supervisor, State Audit Guard, Operator Review)
what_was_created.decision_policies: 10 decision policies (QA, QC, Tester, visual rejection, preview, production, blocker, fake success, no blind retry, forbidden actions)
what_was_created.reference_registries: Positive and negative reference registries with usage policy
what_was_created.reports: Validation report, readiness report, and this operator review packet

operator_can_approve: Approve standards pack for integration into QA/QC/Tester agents
Request modifications to specific standards or policies
Authorize external standards acquisition in future task
operator_can_reject: Reject standards pack and request corrections
Block integration until modifications are made

key_policies_to_review.note: Explicitly states only operator can set production_accepted=true
Lists 10 forbidden actions with blocker/critical severity
Detects dry runs reported as real, fake prompt_ids, fake assets
Requires explicit corrective changes for every retry

recommended_verdict: Operator review of standards pack contents recommended before integration layer.
